title: rangetest: Observe registered before body validation; 4.00 path leaks observer slot
description: coap_rangetest.c:773-781 coap_resource_parse_observe runs before lichen_rangetest_interval_decode (:782); a body that fails decode has already consumed an observer slot from CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_OBSERVERS - spoofed-source junk requests can starve the pool. Fix: validate body first, register observe last.
close_reason: Observe registration moved after full request validation in lichen_rangetest_get_handler (4.00/5.03 no longer consume an observer slot; RFC 7641 comment). Regression test test_observe_registered_only_on_success asserts the observer list stays empty on the 4.00 path, registers on success, and deregisters on Observe=1. (Rescued uncommitted work from a timed-out agent session; verified and landed.) Twister qemu_x86/atom: 1/1 config, 8/8 cases. Commit 4c33ee2345.
